_comment: Manual PubMed search overrides for faculty the scraper can't disambiguate automatically.
_format: Keys are lowercased faculty names, values are the exact PubMed search string to use.

_examples.Hanks BA: Lastname + middle initial — used when scraper only knows first initial
_examples.ORCID:0000-0001-2345-6789: ORCID if not found on faculty page
_examples.ComputedAuthors:12345678 Hanks B: Force a specific Computed Authors seed PMID
